v=Path('/workspaces/.agent-state/kprog-lanes/V');r=Path('/workspaces/repository/kprog/results/kprog_verification_20261107');sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();rc=1
try:
 m=json.loads((r/'arm64-xdp-host-integration.json').read_text());d=m['canonical_arm_thread_pointer_reference'];gz=r/'arm64-xdp-host-integration.log.gz';old=gz.read_bytes();raw=gzip.decompress(old);mark=('\n'+d['archive_marker']+'\n').encode();a=raw.index(mark)+len(mark);b=raw.find(b'\n=== ',a);end=b if b>=0 else len(raw);block=raw[a:end];assert sha(block)==d['archive_block_sha256'];rows=[json.loads(l) for l in block.splitlines()];e=next(x for x in rows if x['name']=='artifact/reference');data=base64.b64decode(e['base64']);assert sha(data)==e['sha256']==d['executed_reference_binary_sha256'];assert len(data)==e['bytes'];packed=lzma.compress(data,preset=6);assert lzma.decompress(packed)==data
 e.update(name='artifact/reference.xz',bytes=len(packed),sha256=sha(packed),base64=base64.b64encode(packed).decode(),compression='xz',uncompressed_bytes=len(data),uncompressed_sha256=sha(data));newblock=''.join(json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True)+'\n' for x in rows).encode();d['archive_block_sha256_before_lossless_compaction']=d['archive_block_sha256'];d['archive_block_sha256']=sha(newblock);d['executed_reference_binary_archive_name']='artifact/reference.xz';d['executed_reference_binary_archive_compression']='xz';d['executed_reference_binary_uncompressed_bytes']=len(data)
 # Retain each prior gzip member's actual bytes and replace only the final MRS member.
 marker=gzip.compress(mark+newblock,mtime=0);pieces=[];remaining=old
 import zlib
 found=False
 while remaining:
  z=zlib.decompressobj(wbits=31);part=z.decompress(remaining)+z.flush();used=len(remaining)-len(z.unused_data);assert used>0;member=remaining[:used]
  if part.startswith(mark):assert not found;assert part==mark+block;pieces.append(marker);found=True
  else:pieces.append(member)
  remaining=z.unused_data
 assert found;new=b''.join(pieces);verify=gzip.decompress(new);a2=verify.index(mark)+len(mark);b2=verify.find(b'\n=== ',a2);assert sha(verify[a2:b2 if b2>=0 else None])==d['archive_block_sha256'];assert len(new)<len(old)
 assert gz.read_bytes()==old;gz.write_bytes(new);(r/'arm64-xdp-host-integration.json').write_text(json.dumps(m,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n');(v/'mrs-compact-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps({'gzip_before_bytes':len(old),'gzip_after_bytes':len(new),'executed_binary_bytes':len(data),'xz_bytes':len(packed),'executed_binary_sha256':sha(data),'xz_sha256':sha(packed),'prior_gzip_members_byte_identical':True,'lossless_roundtrip':True},indent=2)+'\n');print('LOSSLESS COMPACT',len(old),'->',len(new),'binary',len(data),'xz',len(packed),'SHA',sha(data),flush=True);rc=0
except Exception:traceback.print_exc()
finally:(v/'mrs-compact.exit').write_text(str(rc)+'\n')
raise SystemExit(rc)
